reader.requirement: At 85 the integer-1 of WRITE ... ADVANCING integer-1 LINE(S) is an integer numeric literal (no digit positions right of the decimal point, §1985:III.2) that is positive or zero and, since SR5 allows zero but not a sign, written without a sign; a negative, signed, non-integer or nonnumeric operand in that position is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ctx.Edition.Cite selects the citation in the COBOL2365 message only; the accept/refuse decision takes no edition

reader.edition-search: Read ScreenAdvancingCount and its caller whole; IsUnsignedForm and IsIntegerOperand are pure form tests (no EditionContext, DialectLevel or ConstructRegistry).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: c4-refuse draws the same seven COBOL2365 at --std 2023 (plus COBOL0902 for LABEL RECORDS, unrelated)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover zero and the '+0' form; -1, -0, +3, 1.0, 2.5, a nonnumeric literal, SPACE, leading zeros and the figurative ZERO are covered only by this read's probes

probes.expected: refused: negative (SR5), signed (III.2, SR5 allows zero only), digit positions right of the decimal point (III.2 item 1), not numeric
accepted: 0 advances no line (LINAGE-COUNTER unchanged), 3 and 00002 advance 3 and 2

probes.printed: BEFORE ADVANCING ZERO LINES accepted, LINAGE-COUNTER unchanged
probes.expected: value zero is allowed by SR5; whether a figurative constant may stand for integer-1 at 85 is a question of §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 and the III.2 definition, see notes

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR5  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5
OK  §1985:III.2  (2. <u>DEFINITIONS</u>)  the text is in the clause
OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3  (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.3

reader.notes: SR5's value and sign constraint is enforced on the literal's written form at every edition. Open question outside SR5: the screen admits the figurative ZERO in integer-1's position at 85 under a 2023 citation, while §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 permits a figurative constant 'whenever literal appears in a format' and the WRITE format writes integer-1; NIST SQ101M (a net, not authority) writes BEFORE ADVANCING ZERO (kb/Work PB87). Its value is zero, which SR5 permits, so it does not break this rule.
reader.at-2023: c4-refuse: seven COBOL2365 at the same lines at --std 2023

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-243/runs): r4-refuse-001: COBOL2365 at '0.0' (a digit position right of the point), 'ALL "1"', 'HIGH-VALUE' and '-00' (a signed zero); the witness pb5805-write-advancing-plus-sign-85 refuses '+0'. r4-forms-001 (LINAGE 30, exit 0): ADVANCING ZEROS LINES and ZEROES LINE leave LINAGE-COUNTER at 001 (zero allowed, no repositioning), 29 LINES advances to 030 (the page body's last line). ALL ZERO is accepted like ZERO (ALL redundant for a figurative, IV.4.2.2.2.3 rule 3). Every written sign, every fraction digit and every non-ZERO figurative or nonnumeric operand is refused; every unsigned integer literal, leading zeros and zero included, is admitted: SR5's value/sign constraint holds on each form. The one open operand class -- the figurative ZERO in integer-1's place, admitted by ScreenAdvancingCount (BoundFigurative Kind 'Z') with no 1985 arm and a 2023 citation -- does not break SR5 (its value is zero, which SR5 allows); whether it is integer-1 at all is the III.2/IV.4.2.2.2.3 question ('whenever literal appears in a format' vs exception (1) 'If the literal is restricted to a numeric literal, the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO'), a reading CCVS85 SQ101M takes as legal (kb/Work PB87). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR5  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5'; 'OK  §1985:III.2  (2. <u>DEFINITIONS</u>)  the text is in the clause'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3  (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values)  the text is in the clause; it lies in SRL3.1'.
